invocation.output:
The edit didn't apply the curly characters — the file contains straight ASCII quotes. Let me write the line with explicit code points.Done. The tagline line now reads exactly:

`Tagline: “Fast” and ‘simple’`

Verified code points: U+201C, U+201D, U+2018, U+2019 — no straight quotes remain. The other three lines are unchanged.

Note: the ordinary Edit tool call silently wrote straight ASCII quotes back (the tool layer normalized them), so I applied the change via a Python script using explicit `\u201c`-style escapes and then verified the bytes on disk.
